title: Toho's Godzilla Minus Zero has crossed $100 million at the worldwide box office in its second weekend (Variety 16 Nov, Deadline 15 Nov), with about $49 million from North America (The Numbers), ahead of its Indian cinema release, IMAX included, on Friday 20 November via PVR INOX Pictures.
headline: Godzilla Minus Zero Crosses $100M Before Its 20 Nov India Release
